solution.p: Here are two different explanations of how two negative numbers can be added together.
Use a number line. Lets find -8+3.
First, find -8 on the number line. Next, since we are adding a positive number, we move right, in the positive direction, by 3 units. We will reach {-5} on the number line, which is the answer.
A second method asks you to think in terms of money. Lets find -8+3.
The first number is -8. Since its negative, its like you lost 8 dollars while gambling at the casino this morning.
The second number is 3. Since its positive, its like you won 3 dollars while gambling at the casino this afternoon.
Since you lost more money than you won, overall you have lost, implying the answer is negative.
Since you lost 8 dollars and then won 3 dollars, it makes sense that you lost the difference of 8 and 3 dollars, which is {5} dollars. So the final answer is: -8+3={-5}.
